sloka: देवतानाम् पितृऋणाम् च माता पित्रोस् तथैव च ।मा स्म कार्षीत् स शुश्रूषाम् यस्य आर्यो अनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-४६॥
transliteration: devatānām pitṛṛṇām ca mātā pitros tathaiva ca ।mā sma kārṣīt sa śuśrūṣām yasya āryo anumate gataḥ ॥2-75-46॥

translations.english: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother, acquire the sin in the same way as a person who fails to show obedience to the gods and the ancestors and to serve his parents
